MIND. [1] [Con.]
Inability to sustain any mental effort.
Hypochondriasis and hysteria from suppression of, or too free indulgence in, sexual instinct, with low-spiritedness, anxiety and sadness.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Con.]
Sick headaches, with inability to urinate ; great giddiness, < lying in bed, when everything in room seems to go round.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Con.]
Objects look red ; rainbow colored ; striped, confused spots.
Weakness of sight ; amaurosis.
Weakness and dazzling of eyes, together with dizziness, and debility, especially of arms and legs ; on walking, staggering as if drunk.
Aversion to light, without inflammation of eyes.
Ulcers on cornea, right to left.
Burning of eyes.
Could scarcely raise eyelids, they seemed pressed down by a heavy weight ; disposed to fall asleep.
Burning on inner surface of lids.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Con.]
Accumulation of earwax, looking blood red, or like decayed paper, with pus or mucus.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Con.]
After every stool, trembling, weakness and palpitation.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Con.]
Intermittent flow of urine with cutting after micturition.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Con.]
Sexual desire without erection.
Bad effects from suppressed sexual desire, or from excessive indulgence.
Discharge of prostatic fluid on every change of emotion, without voluptuous thoughts, or while expelling feces ; with itching of prepuce.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Con.]
Ill effects of suppressed sexual instinct, or non-gratification of sexual appetite.
Induration and enlargement of ovaries or womb, with lancinating pains.
Indurations, especially of a scrofulous nature or from injuries.
Burning, stinging, darting pains in neck of uterus, with indurations and scirrhosities.
Shriveling of mamma, without sexual desire.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Con.]
Dry spot in larynx, where there are crawling and almost constant irritation to cough.
   

COUGH. [27] [Con.]
Powerful, spasmodic paroxysms of cough excited by itching and tickling in chest and throat, or by a dry spot in larynx, < at night and when lying down, greatly fatiguing patient.
Cough, when first lying down, during day or evening ; is obliged to sit up and cough it out, after which rest.
Lying down and taking a deep breath cause cough.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Con.]
Stitches as with needles in left mamma.
Hardness of right mamma, with painfulness to touch, and nightly stitches in it.
Hard, scirrhous-like tumors.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Con.]
Indurated and swollen cervical glands in scrofulous children.
   

NERVES. [36] [Con.]
Tremulous weakness after every stool, > in open air.
Paroxysms of hysteria and hypochondriasis from abstinence from sexual intercourse.
   

FEVER. [40] [Con.]
Great heat, internal and external, with great nervousness.
Sweat day and night, as soon as one sleeps, or even when closing eyes.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Con.]
Swelling and induration of glands, with tingling and stitches ; after contusions and bruises.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Con.]
Scrofulous constitutions ; strumous condition, enlarged glands.
